statements.t: The Company expects to complete the VELA-TEEN clinical trial in the fourth quarter of 2026 and plans to submit final results for presentation at a scientific conference in the first quarter of 2027.
The Company expects to announce initial topline results following a predefined unblinding protocol in the first quarter of 2027.
The Company expects to commence enrollment in the Phase 3 NOVA trial as per plans in November 2026.
The Company expects to have sufficient capital to fund its operating expenses and capital expenditure requirements to mid-2028.
The increase of $18.7 million is primarily related to accrued milestone license fees for a regulatory milestone associated with the expected acceptance of the Company's BLA submission.

At the same time, we believe our financial position and projected cash runway into mid-2028 position us well to prepare for the expected commercial launch of sonelokimab in the U.S. next year, and to continue advancing its broader potential across inflammatory diseases."
The company intends to continue the assessment of sonelokimab in PPP with its planned Phase 3 trial NOVA.

risks.t: difficulty enrolling patients in clinical trials
state and federal healthcare reform measures that could result in reduced demand for MoonLake’s product candidates
reliance on third parties to conduct and support its preclinical studies and clinical trials
